authorityRule: C0-S fixes ceilings; Package and C0-B record authenticated observations and derived pass-fail only.

packageDeltaSpecifyBasis.disposition: keep every numeric ceiling unchanged; compare candidate frontend raw bytes with the authenticated pre-ADE-0006A Sage frontend baseline, while retaining the static Tauri control for packaged runtime and all non-frontend package deltas

observationFiles.eachFile: one regular non-symlink file whose exact bytes and SHA-256 are authenticated by the curated results descriptor
observationFiles.inventoryRule: the C0-B raw root contains exactly the ordered inventory and no other entry

packageReceiptIdentity.authority: one exact Package receipt revalidated with its retained raw sidecars
packageReceiptIdentity.selectedInstaller: the C0-B plan selects exactly one of msi or nsis for both participants
packageReceiptIdentity.installedExecutableBinding: digest of receipt SHA-256, participant, installer kind, member-manifest SHA-256, installed executable SHA-256, and installed executable bytes

packagedFootprint.stateSetup: exact-PID UI Automation with semantic controls only; screen coordinates, global input, debug ports, and CDP are forbidden
packagedFootprint.cleanLaunch: fresh marked disposable durable and WebView profile, no prior participant process, OS file cache left natural and recorded
packagedFootprint.deadlineRule: schedule each snapshot from one absolute monotonic baseline; capturedTick must be greater than or equal to dueTick and strictly less than the next dueTick, using dueTick plus one interval for the final snapshot; any missing, duplicated, nonmonotonic, or out-of-window snapshot invalidates the whole pair
packagedFootprint.adr0005Projection: five one-second-spaced points after the eight-second settle; each launch contributes its median and the campaign reports median plus nearest-rank P95
packagedFootprint.cpuAggregation: nearest-rank P95 across all 200 valid per-interval candidate samples and separately across all 200 control samples
packagedFootprint.privateBytesGate: for each state, derive candidate P95 and control P95 from the 25 ADR-0005 projection values per participant; the incremental observation is candidate P95 minus control P95 and must not exceed the frozen incremental private-byte ceiling
packagedFootprint.latencyBinding: every launch records one QPC-domain spawn-start/window-ready, trusted-input/result-paint, and trusted-tab-activation/result-paint span inside that launch's close boundary; the three reported durations are derived exactly from those spans and the authenticated campaign QPC frequency
packagedFootprint.invalidAttempt: retain only typed sanitized disposition, discard the entire attempted pair, and collect a fresh replacement; never substitute or interpolate

characterization.freshEpoch: every core run, cold fixture cycle, saturation cycle, fairness cycle, and coalescing policy run owns a unique marked disposable profile and PID-creation identity
characterization.coldNativeReceipt: every cold fixture cycle embeds exactly one create-new schema-v2 native receipt bound to case cold-cycle, runtime epoch 1, the admitted fixture hash and bytes, PID plus full process creation FILETIME, QPC frequency, initialize/ready/prompt/output/cancel/close/job-zero/close-commit anchors, and typed WAL convergence
characterization.coldSampleOwnership: each 30-sample cold metric contains exactly one sample from every one of the 30 cold epochs; spawnToProcessReady, initialize, firstNormalizedOutput, cancelDispatch, and cancelTerminal are derived from that epoch's native receipt; coldActivation is derived from the epoch activation receipt through visible-ready after native ready commit; explicitClose is derived from the outer close receipt through the later of zero owned descendants and WAL convergence
characterization.coreLatencyBinding: each core paint sample owns a unique QPC-domain start/end span inside one of exactly five core epochs and is derived from the authenticated campaign QPC frequency; every core epoch owns exactly 20 native-receipt-to-paint samples, 20 input-to-paint samples, and one forced-teardown span whose anchors are exactly close-requested through zero descendants
characterization.invalidAttempt: retain only typed sanitized disposition and bind it to a fresh replacement epoch; no invalid observations contribute to metrics
characterization.entry: initialize committed ready, projection revision observed by WebView, no Turn active, ingress/egress/journal queues empty, WAL converged below checkpoint target
characterization.deadlineRule: schedule each snapshot from one absolute monotonic baseline; capturedTick must be greater than or equal to dueTick and strictly less than the next dueTick, using dueTick plus one interval for the final snapshot; any missing, duplicated, nonmonotonic, or out-of-window snapshot invalidates the whole epoch
characterization.cpuFormula: sum process CPU-time delta across the owned tree divided by wall-time delta and one logical core, multiplied by 100
characterization.cpuAggregation: nearest-rank P95 across all valid per-interval samples; intervals spanning spawn, exit, or membership change are invalid

processMembership.nativeAndRenderer: candidate Sage parent plus descendants whose parent chain reaches that exact PID and process creation time
processMembership.fixtureTree: child root recorded from the verified spawn handle plus descendants whose parent chain reaches that exact PID and creation time
processMembership.privateBytes: sum platform private/unique committed bytes for current members at each sample
processMembership.orphanCheck: zero living descendants from either owned tree 5 seconds after close

latencyAnchors.spawnToProcessReady: monotonic instant immediately before verified spawn through successful child-process handle creation
latencyAnchors.initialize: first initialize request byte write through durable ready commit
latencyAnchors.firstNormalizedOutput: last prompt request byte written through first structurally validated normalized Item accepted by Rust
latencyAnchors.nativeReceiptToPaint: Rust frame receipt monotonic timestamp through browser performance.now mark after the projection paint containing that revision
latencyAnchors.inputToPaint: trusted semantic input event timestamp through browser performance.now mark after resulting paint
latencyAnchors.tabSwitch: trusted semantic tab activation through browser performance.now mark after the selected tab panel paint
latencyAnchors.cancelDispatch: trusted Cancel activation through final cancel byte write or typed local no-write disposition
latencyAnchors.cancelTerminal: trusted Cancel activation through durable terminal Turn commit
latencyAnchors.coldActivation: trusted activation receipt for a cold session through durable ready commit and visible ready projection
latencyAnchors.explicitClose: close request receipt through zero owned process descendants and WAL convergence
latencyAnchors.forcedTeardown: forced teardown request through zero exact owned descendants

deltaFormulas.pairedPackaged: candidate percentile minus the matched packaged control percentile; paired metrics must pass both the absolute candidate ceiling and controlRegressionMax
deltaFormulas.candidateCharacterization: candidate-only ACP metrics pass their absolute ceiling; no static-control value or regression delta exists
deltaFormulas.package: frontendRawBytes is candidate frontend raw bytes minus the authenticated frontendSizeBaseline; every other package delta is candidate minus the matched static Tauri control; all are derived only by the authenticated Package receipt and C0-B does not reproduce them
deltaFormulas.percentile: sort ascending and select element ceil(p*n), one-indexed; no interpolation

saturation.eachBoundary: run exact-limit then limit-plus-one in one unique fresh candidate runtime epoch

coalescing.selectionRule: lowest nearest-rank P95 with zero saturation observations and zero SQLite writes per text delta

persistence.markerBinding: each ordered marker belongs to one of two non-overlapping launches and records an in-launch QPC checkpoint-start/completion span; duration is derived exactly from the authenticated campaign QPC frequency, WAL after checkpoint cannot exceed WAL before checkpoint and must be below the frozen target, and convergence must be true

epochLedger.fixtureIdentity: fixture PID plus creation time when the contracted purpose spawns the fixture
epochLedger.closeGate: zero exact descendants and zero normal Sage-data mutations before an epoch is valid
